'''Randy''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG096|Training Wrecks]]''. He was not given an official name in the Japanese version.

Randy is one of the [[Pokémon Trainer]]s training under [[Rocky]] on [[Muscle Island]]. He was first seen on the island when {{TRT}} arrived after their [[Team Rocket's mechas|Magikarp submarine]] was swept away by a giant wave. Randy was doing arm exercises using a heavy-looking steel {{i|Poké Ball}}. When he discovered the trio lurking in the bushes, he assumed that they were on the island to join the training, and thus arranged a program for them.

After {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were also given exercise programs, Randy went up to [[Max]] in order to give him some support and watched on as the group—save for Ash as he was battling Rocky at the time—and Team Rocket continued with their exercise programs.
